status: UNDER CONSTRUCTION — the vocabulary is not written yet and no Data API facts have been verified. Nothing here is ready to answer a caller. Do not route work to L0178 until this field says otherwise.
summary: Produces developer COOKBOOK RECIPES for the Learnosity Data API — a precise, host-language-neutral procedure for reading from and writing to a Learnosity item bank server-to-server (endpoints, actions, request shape, paging, error handling, write safety). Documentation-only: it covers the published documentation plus the un-written tricks and tips, and never calls a Learnosity API itself. It emits a recipe to follow, NOT item content and NOT runnable code.
in_scope: How to sign and send a Data API request server-to-server with the official Learnosity SDK, and how that signing differs from the front-end APIs
Which endpoint and action answer a given question, and the request fields legal for that (endpoint, action) pair
How to page a result set to completion — the failure this dialect exists to prevent is a truncated read that returns a valid response and a silently incomplete record set
How to read the response envelope: distinguishing transport failure from an API-level error the envelope reports
Write safety as recipe content: what a write persists, what re-running it does, and how to stage it against a scratch target
The verification steps that tell a developer their Data API integration is correct AND complete
out_of_scope: Authoring the assessment item CONTENT being written (stems, options, answer keys, passages) — that is L0176. This dialect describes the OPERATION that moves content into a bank; it does not compose the content
Embedding and configuring the Author API authoring experience (item/activity editor and browser) — that is L0177

Delivering assessments to learners (Items API) and reading responses/scores/reports (Reports API) — each its own sibling dialect, none built yet. Say no dialect covers it rather than stretching this one

Calling the Learnosity API. This dialect is documentation-only: the caller's own code signs and sends every request with the caller's own consumer key. L0178 holds no credentials and performs no requests
Integrations for any platform other than Learnosity
Emitting runnable host-language code — the recipe is a language-neutral procedure the caller implements in their own stack
